friendly_name: Auto-apply audit edits; gate reserved for future judgment classes
source_description: Fix GitHub issue #259 — felix-doc-auditor over-gates mechanical edits. The current auditor routes every edit-bearing audit through the Level-1 approval gate regardless of change_type, but all currently-defined change_types are deterministic-known-fix surfaces by definition (if the auditor detected the drift, it knows the correct value from a system-state source). Mission adds a route_audit_decisions.py helper that partitions edit proposals into auto-apply (known change_types) and gate (unknown — fail-safe), updates AGENTS.md to invoke it and act on the partition, and codifies the invariant in § 7.5 that judgment-required cases go to docs-debt issues, not edit proposals.
